app.name: kilna
app.tagline: From raw idea to shipped work.

status.noProfile: This workspace has no active profile.

empty.title: Nothing selected
empty.body: Pick a work on the left, or add one.
empty.worksBody: A work is one song, chapter or episode — whatever your profile calls it.
empty.worksFilteredBody: Clear the search or the filters to see everything again.
empty.catalogueBody: Score a work and it appears here, ranked.
empty.trashBody: Anything you delete waits here until you empty it.
empty.journalBody: Add a work, score one, plan a release - it all gets written down here.
empty.journalClearBody: Warnings show up here. There are none right now.
empty.historyBody: What you do to this work will be listed here.

work.title: Title
work.statusPinned: Set by hand — the automation leaves it alone.
work.unpinStatusHint: Hand the status back to the automation and work it out now.

versions.title: Versions
versions.none: No versions in this role yet.
versions.draftPlaceholder: Paste or write a new draft — it is kept whole, not as a diff

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.rule: The living inventory of the design system. Screens take their primitives from here — a control that is not on this page does not go on any other.
styleguide.sampleBody: Body text carries the reading weight of every screen.
styleguide.hint: A hint sits under the control.
styleguide.iconsNote: Icons come from lucide — never from text glyphs.

data.statusHint: Statuses follow what has happened — a score, a slot, a release. This shows where the words have fallen behind the facts, without changing anything. Works whose status you set by hand are left out.
data.exportHint: Every work as markdown — front matter, full bodies, scores, releases and notes. Readable without kilna.
data.backupHint: The whole workspace in one file, taken safely while the app is running.
data.restoreHint: To restore, close kilna and put the backup in place of that file.
data.importHint: Bring in works, drafts and scores from an earlier system. Titles already here are left alone.
data.imported: Imported {{works}} works, {{versions}} drafts, {{scores}} scores. Skipped {{skipped}} already here.

dashboard.quietBody: Everything is scored, booked or already out. Write something new, or take the evening.

calendar.dropToUnschedule: Drop here to return it to the queue
calendar.pinSlotHint: A stronger work will not take it.
calendar.clearDateHint: Clearing the date returns it to the queue.
calendar.layoutNeedsRhythm: Set a release rhythm in the profile first.
calendar.layoutPreview_one: {{count}} release would land between {{from}} and {{to}}. Nothing is booked yet.
calendar.layoutPreview_other: {{count}} releases would land between {{from}} and {{to}}. Nothing is booked yet.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.queueHint: Strongest first. Pick one, then give it a date.
calendar.queueEmpty: Nothing waiting. Add a release from a work.
calendar.displaced: {{title}} lost the slot and went back to the queue.
calendar.unscored: Not scored yet — it cannot take a slot from a work that has been.

preview.held: {{title}} holds this day and scores at least as well
preview.pinned: {{title}} holds this day, and the date is pinned

score.title: Score
score.partial: {{filled}} of {{count}} axes filled — the unfilled ones are skipped, not counted as zero.

catalogue.staleHint: The work was edited after this score was taken.

gapHint.unscheduled: Judged, but nothing has gone out and nothing is booked.
gapHint.stale: The work changed after it was scored.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.unavailable: Claude Code is not available on this machine.
assistant.placeholder: Ask about this work — Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line, / for actions
assistant.placeholderAnywhere: Ask anything — Enter sends, Shift+Enter for a new line
assistant.deleteBody: The whole conversation goes with it — questions, answers and runs. This cannot be undone.
assistant.insertBody: The answer becomes a version of this work, exactly as written.
assistant.openBusy: Open the assistant — runs are going
assistant.noChats: Ask from a work's card, or start one here about anything.
assistant.batchQueued: {{started}} started, {{queued}} waiting for a free slot.
assistant.batchNothing: Nothing to send — those are already running.
assistant.taskEnded: The assistant stopped without an answer.
assistant.waitingTitle: The assistant is waiting on you in

editor.axesHint: Label and weight. Keys are fixed — past scores are stored under them, and renaming one would orphan its history.
editor.tiersHint: What a score licenses you to do, and the total it takes to get there.
editor.rhythmHint: How often releases go out. The auto-layout keeps this many days between them; leave it empty for no set pace.
editor.keysHint: Existing works keep the status and kind they already had, even if you edit the wording here.

error.database: The workspace database refused that. Nothing was changed.
error.io: Could not reach the workspace on disk.
error.schemaTooNew: This workspace was written by a newer version of kilna. Update the app to open it.
error.notFound: That is not here any more — it was probably deleted in another view.
error.assistant: The assistant could not be reached. Check that Claude Code is installed and on your PATH.
error.notRestorable: The work this belonged to is in the trash too. Restore that first.
error.slotPinned: That date is being kept for something else.
error.slotHeld: That date is taken by work that scores at least as well.
error.layoutStale: The calendar changed since this preview was drawn. Lay the queue out again.

crash.title: This screen stopped working
crash.body: The rest of the app is fine. Try again — if it keeps happening, the detail below is worth reporting.

toast.slotUnpinned: That date can be contested again.
toast.layoutFailed: Could not lay the queue out

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Nothing leaves for good until you say so.
trash.emptyBody_one: {{count}} entry will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
trash.emptyBody_other: {{count}} entries will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.

journal.title: History
journal.status.resynced_one: {{count}} work restated to match the facts.
journal.status.resynced_other: {{count}} works restated to match the facts.
journal.release.notReady: “{{title}}” goes out on {{date}} but is not ready.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Titles, drafts, notes and what the assistant said.
